presets.title: D366 300A Contactor Hold-On Interlock
presets.description: Path 1: 400A Mega Fuse -> D366 300A -> 300A Contactor -> Loads. Path 2: 5A Inline Fuse -> small Dash Switch + 4-Pin Hold Relay routed through the PLC Control Bus Duct. Contactor only listens to Dash Switch to turn OFF when D366 < 300A.

presets.title: Automotive 4-Pin & 5-Pin Relay Harness
presets.description: Native Bosch/ISO relays (COIL+ (86), COIL- (85), COM (30), NO (87), NC (87a)) with local wireless ⏚ grounds: switch closes K1, K1 energizes K2 which moves load from DRL NC (87a) to HIGH BEAM NO (87).

presets.title: Full Adder Sub-Circuit Hierarchy
presets.description: Double-tap FULL ADDER to peek inside its nested HALF ADDER sub-circuits with live electrical flow.

presets.title: RC Capacitor Charge & LED Flow
presets.description: EveryCircuit-style live current dot animation with wireless ⏚ grounds: toggle POWER switch to watch the capacitor charge/discharge through the LED.

presets.title: NMOS Transistor Logic Inverter
presets.description: See how digital logic works physically with an N-Channel MOSFET, 1kΩ pull-up resistor, and wireless ⏚ ground symbols.

presets.title: 4-Bit Counter & 7-Seg Hex Display
presets.description: Live binary counter pulsing current particles into a 4-bit hexadecimal 7-segment display.

presets.title: Blank Sub-Circuit Sandbox
presets.description: Wire gates or analog components between IN and OUT pins, then tap CREATE CHIP to save as a custom IC.

presets.title: Dual-Battery Camper Split-Charge (VSR)
presets.description: Alternator charges Starter Battery; when >13.3V, Comparator pulls in the VSR Contactor to charge the House Battery and run Cabin Loads.

presets.title: Trailer 7-Pin Lighting & Brake Harness
presets.description: Tow-rig 7-pin plug distribution: Tail/Marker, Left & Right Stop/Turn, and PWM Electric Brake Controller routed cleanly through a 7-Pin Harness Duct.

presets.title: 2-Speed Radiator Fan Control (Low/High)
presets.description: Low-speed stage feeds Radiator Fan through a 1.2Ω ballast resistor; High-speed override relay bypasses the resistor for full 12V cooling.

presets.title: PLC Start/Stop Motor Latch + E-Stop
presets.description: Industrial 24V PLC cabinet ladder logic: E-Stop (NC) + Overload (NC) feed momentary START PB and K1 Seal-In Latch driving Motor Contactor + RUN/STOP Lamps.

subCircuits.name: AUTO RELAY 4-PIN
subCircuits.description: Bosch/ISO 4-Pin SPST Relay (30 Bat, 86 Coil+, 85 Coil- -> 87 NO, Coil State).

subCircuits.name: AUTO RELAY 5-PIN
subCircuits.description: Bosch/ISO 5-Pin SPDT Changeover Relay (30 COM, 86+, 85- -> 87 NO & 87a NC).

subCircuits.name: AUTO LATCH RELAY
subCircuits.description: Bistable Automotive Latching Relay with nested 4-Pin Relay & SR coil memory.

subCircuits.name: HALF ADDER
subCircuits.description: Adds two 1-bit inputs (A, B) into SUM and CARRY.

internalGraph.title: HALF ADDER
internalGraph.description: XOR for SUM + AND for CARRY

subCircuits.name: FULL ADDER
subCircuits.description: Nested sub-circuit built from 2x HALF ADDER chips + OR gate.

internalGraph.title: FULL ADDER
internalGraph.description: Two nested HALF ADDERs + OR Carry combiner

subCircuits.name: 300A COMPARATOR
subCircuits.description: Conditions Current Sensor TRIG into OVER_300A & SAFE_OPEN control signals.

subCircuits.name: RELAY COIL DRIVER
subCircuits.description: Drives the bypass Power Relay coil when >300A hold or manual override is asserted.

subCircuits.name: 300A HOLD INTERLOCK
subCircuits.description: Nested IC containing RELAY COIL DRIVER: energizes bypass relay to prevent switch-off above 300A.
